3 hPOTENTIAL CAPACITY / WEEK
$650MONTHLY CAPACITY VALUE
How this estimate works

Hours × selected reduction = potential weekly capacity. Weekly capacity × 52 ÷ 12 × hourly value = monthly capacity value. Default inputs: 10 × 30% = 3 hours/week; 3 × 52 ÷ 12 × $50 = $650/month.

This is an assumption you set, not a forecast. Capacity value is not cash saved or extra revenue. Implementation, software costs, oversight and maintenance are excluded. A diagnostic checks what is practical.
